d:
Most of the journey happens quietly. Same routines, same efforts, same doubts in the back of your mind all along the road asking if any of it really matters.
But that’s the thing. Progress rarely feels like progress while we’re in it. It just feels like walking. One more day, one more small thing done, one more moment where you could have quit and didn’t.
But later we look back with distance and we can see the person we became somewhere along the way without noticing.
Our biggest dreams aren’t built in one big leap. They’re built in all the small steps we take.
